h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Munger

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Munger

items.pText: Munger is an old town on the south bank of the Ganga, with river breezes, humid summers and a strong monsoon. Schools and colonies here want playground equipment that stays in good condition for years, and that depends as much on simple upkeep as on how it was made. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,540 km away, and delivers it to Bihar by road.

Every installation comes with maintenance steps from us at handover. Share your site size, the age group and some photos, and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Our team or a dealer in eastern India installs the equipment once you approve the layout and quote.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

items: sweep the flooring, remove litter and check that nothing sharp or broken is lying in the play area.
check bolts, chains, swing seats and spring riders for wear or looseness.
wash down all surfaces, look for soil washed away from footings and check drainage.

items.q: How often should playground equipment be inspected?
items.a: A quick check every week, a closer look at bolts, chains and springs every month, and a full wash-down and footing check after the monsoon.

items.q: Who do we call if something breaks?
items.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Share photos of the damage so we can assess it.
Yes. Equipment is made at our Vasai factory, sent by road and installed by our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
